verdicts.title: A Parametric and Feasibility Study for Data Sampling of the Dynamic Mode Decomposition--Range, Resolution, and Universal Convergence States
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Scientific research and engineering practice often require the modeling and decomposition of nonlinear systems. The Dynamic Mode Decomposition (DMD) is a novel Koopman-based technique that effectively dissects high-dimensional nonlinear systems into periodically distinct constituents on reduced-order subspaces. The shared word 'resolution' refers to sampling resolution, not proof resolution.

verdicts.title: Complexity of Networks (reprise)

verdicts.title: Dynamics of hyperbolic iwips
